description: Check whether Sunk City can also run on an Oculus Rift. The app is OpenXR + Vulkan, so a PC build with the Rift's OpenXR runtime (Oculus/Meta runtime on Windows, or Monado's Rift driver on Linux) may work largely unchanged. To check: Windows build (ash/openxr crates, shader paths), the Oculus Touch interaction profile (already among the suggested bindings), and GPU budget at the Rift's refresh rate (80/90 Hz).

status.comment: Prepared: native/build-windows.sh cross-builds sunk-city.exe (x86_64-pc-windows-gnu via cargo-zigbuild; builds clean, no code changes needed) and packs shaders, start.bat and optionally a net (NET=nice-net) into build/windows/sunk-city.zip. Human checklist on a Windows PC with the Rift: 1) download openxr_loader.dll (x64) from a Khronos OpenXR-SDK release into the folder, 2) Meta/Oculus app set as active OpenXR runtime, 3) run start.bat, 4) send me sunk-city.log (GPU ms line, any error). Touch controllers are among the suggested bindings. Unknown until run: whether the Meta PC runtime offers XR_KHR_vulkan_enable2 (we require it) — the log will say.
